result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the restaurant listing area has text collisions and content is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” appears to overlap or duplicate itself: the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine text collide on the same line, making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Correct the metadata layout by using a consistent inline flex row with spacing, or allow it to wrap cleanly onto separate lines without overlapping.

issues.description: The second restaurant card is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar, leaving its image and likely content inaccessible at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the fixed navigation layering so the final card can be scrolled fully above the navigation bar.
